title: Webview Core API
summary: This module provides the core API for managing a webview component, handling its lifecycle, UI interactions, system integrations like DPI awareness, and communication with the underlying webview runtime.

nodes.label: Handle Application Launch
nodes.title: on_application_did_finish_launching
nodes.description: Manages the application's startup sequence, including window setup and activation policies, especially for non-bundled applications.

nodes.label: Process Webview Permissions
nodes.title: Invoke
nodes.description: Handles permission requests from the webview, such as allowing or denying clipboard read access.

nodes.label: Terminate Webview
nodes.title: terminate
nodes.description: Shuts down and cleans up the webview instance.

nodes.label: Set Window Title
nodes.title: set_title
nodes.description: Sets the title displayed in the webview's host window.

nodes.label: Load HTML Content
nodes.title: set_html
nodes.description: Injects and displays HTML content directly into the webview.

nodes.label: Enable DPI Awareness
nodes.title: enable_dpi_awareness
nodes.description: Configures the process to correctly handle high-DPI displays, ensuring proper scaling and rendering.

nodes.label: Discover Webview Runtime
nodes.title: find_available_client
nodes.description: Locates and identifies an available WebView2 runtime client, either embedded or installed.

nodes.label: Start Event Loop
nodes.title: run
nodes.description: Initiates the main event loop for the webview, processing UI events and messages.

nodes.label: Dispatch UI Function
nodes.title: dispatch
nodes.description: Executes a given function on the webview's UI thread, ensuring thread-safe operations.

nodes.label: Set Window Size
nodes.title: set_size
nodes.description: Adjusts the dimensions (width and height) of the webview's host window.

nodes.label: Initialize with JavaScript
nodes.title: init
nodes.description: Executes initial JavaScript code within the webview context upon its creation.

nodes.label: Set Webview Zoom
nodes.title: set_zoom
nodes.description: Controls the zoom level of the content displayed within the webview, clamping to min/max values.

nodes.label: Get Webview Zoom
nodes.title: get_zoom
nodes.description: Retrieves the current zoom level of the webview content.

nodes.label: Get Window DPI
nodes.title: get_window_dpi
nodes.description: Queries the Dots Per Inch (DPI) scaling factor for a specific window.

nodes.label: Get Browser Version
nodes.title: get_available_browser_version_string
nodes.description: Obtains the version string of the underlying WebView2 browser runtime.

nodes.label: Get Window Size
nodes.title: get_size
nodes.description: Retrieves the current client area dimensions of the webview's host window, and scaled size.

nodes.label: Operating System APIs
nodes.title: OS APIs
nodes.description: External operating system functions for window management, DPI settings, and system information.

nodes.label: WebView2 Runtime API
nodes.title: WebView2 Runtime
nodes.description: The underlying Microsoft WebView2 runtime interface for browser control and events.

nodes.label: Platform Specific Engines
nodes.title: Platform Engines
nodes.description: Module containing platform-specific implementations for webview functionalities (e.g., Win32 Edge, Cocoa WKWebView, GTK WebKit).

groups.label: Application Lifecycle
groups.title: Application Lifecycle Management
groups.description: Manages the startup, execution, and termination of the webview application.

groups.label: UI Presentation & Control
groups.title: User Interface Presentation and Control
groups.description: Handles visual aspects and interactive properties of the webview window and its content.

groups.label: System & Runtime Integration
groups.title: System and Webview Runtime Integration
groups.description: Facilitates interaction with the operating system and discovery/querying of the webview runtime environment.

groups.label: Event & Scripting
groups.title: Event Handling and Scripting
groups.description: Manages webview events, permissions, and the execution of JavaScript code.
